verdict.rationale: Secureframe's MCP docs show agent-specific credentials. An MCP client signs in through an OAuth-style approval and "receives its own token," and an API key option exists for headless CI, script and server setups. However, nothing in the evidence shows these credentials can be scoped or restricted to least privilege (e.g., read-only, per-resource permissions, or role limits). Missing for 10: documented permission scopes or role restrictions on agent tokens and API keys, read-only versus write limits, token expiry and revocation controls, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
